paragraphs.text:
You  and  the  others  advance  up  the  lost  valley  and  into  the 
verdant meadowland at its heart.

Make a combined Natural World and Luck roll: if both succeed, go 
to 620; if both fail, go to 617; if you succeed only at Natural World, 
go to 610; if you succeed only with the Luck roll, go to 630.
